Split Labelled Survey Data by Survey Block

Source: R/split_blocks.R
survey_split_blocks.Rd

Create block-specific views of Labelled Survey Data without changing the return type of survey_fetch_labelled.

Usage

survey_split_blocks(
  dat,
  dict = attr(dat, "dict", exact = TRUE),
  extra_columns = c("externalDataReference", "startDate", "endDate")
)

Arguments

dat

A data frame of Labelled Survey Data: a tibble as returned by survey_fetch_labelled.

dict

A Variable Dictionary: a qualtdict object (a tibble with class qualtdict) as returned by dict_generate.

extra_columns

A character vector of raw Labelled Survey Data columns to retain in each block data set. Defaults to c("externalDataReference", "startDate", "endDate"). Columns absent from the data warn (naming the missing columns) and are skipped. Use NULL to retain no extra columns.

Value

A named list of data frames, one per Survey Block. When dictionary rows have no Survey Block assignment, the list includes "..unassigned".

Details

When dict is not supplied, survey_split_blocks() uses the dict attribute attached by survey_fetch_labelled.

Examples

survey_blocks <- survey_split_blocks(glad_example$labelled_survey_data)
names(survey_blocks)
#> [1] "..unassigned" "Demographics" "GAD7"         "PHQ9"        
survey_blocks$GAD7

# Pass the Variable Dictionary explicitly and keep only the respondent
# identifier alongside each block's Export Variables
survey_blocks <- survey_split_blocks(
  glad_example$labelled_survey_data,
  dict = glad_example$dictionary,
  extra_columns = "externalDataReference"
)
